notes.title: Update 0.7.2.0 Beta
notes.notes: Now when a player launches the first time the game, we execute a benchmark on the machine and set it up to best fit the maximum performances.

notes.title: R4YL Playtest is now live!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow gamers,

We are thrilled to announce that our exciting new title, R4YL is now available for a free Open Beta Steam Playtest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44172589/52af82c2f14243024a84f2ded0fbbe32757bb1cc.png[/img]

We at [b]DFT Games Studios[/b] are working hard to create an engaging, immersive, and thrilling endless runner game. However, we need YOUR help. As we progress, we are eager to hear your thoughts, feedback, and suggestions to help us refine R4YL. This game isn't just ours; it's yours too, and we want to make it as enjoyable and rewarding as possible.

In R4YL, we aim to create stunning visuals, gripping gameplay, and an enchanting environment crafted with meticulous detail. You'll journey through treacherous caves filled with fascinating challenges and collectables. 

Still, remember, the game is far from completion, and we are eager to improve and polish it with your invaluable input.

We can't stress enough how crucial your feedback shapes the final product. Every comment, every suggestion, and constructive criticism can be the difference between a good game and an exceptional one. So, don't hold back - tell us what you love, what you hate, and what you think could be better!

We're not just creating a game; we're creating a community where everyone's voice is heard and appreciated. Whether you're a casual player or a hardcore gamer, we value your feedback and will use it to craft a game you'll love to play and be proud to have contributed to.

Thank you for joining us on this exciting journey. We look forward to reading your feedback and creating an unforgettable gaming experience. So let's make R4YL the game you've always wanted to play!

Best,

The DFT Games Studios Team
